# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Secure event invitation generator. This module defines a single public function `create_event_invitation` that produces an HTML representation of an event invitation. All user‑supplied content is properly escaped to prevent Cross‑Site Scripting (XSS) attacks. """ from __future__ import annotations import html from typing import Final # A minimal, safe HTML template with placeholders for the invitation fields. INVITATION_FORMAT: Final[str] = """ {event_title} - Invitation

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def _sanitize(text: str) -> str: """ Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS. Newlines are converted to
tags for readability. """ escaped = html.escape(text, quote=True) return escaped.replace("\n", "
") def create_event_invitation( title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str = "", ) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title : str The title or name of the event. description : str A comprehensive description of the event. May contain multiple paragraphs. date : str The scheduled date of the event. notes : str, optional Supplementary information or instructions from the organizer. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for safe display in a web page. Notes ----- All input strings are escaped to neutralize any embedded HTML or JavaScript. """ # Sanitize all user inputs safe_title = _sanitize(title) safe_description = _sanitize(description) safe_date = _sanitize(date) safe_notes = _sanitize(notes) # Prepare the notes block only if notes are provided additional_notes_block = ( f'
{safe_notes}
' if safe_notes else "" ) # Populate the template invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=additional_notes_block, ) return invitation_html
